'''Marrok's Fiend fighter'''<ref name="Databank">{{Databank|marrok-s-fiend-fighter|Marrok's Fiend fighter}}</ref> was an [[RP82 Fiend fighter|RP82 Fiend]] [[starfighter]] that the former [[Inquisitor]] [[Marrok]] [[pilot]]ed during his [[time]] as a member of [[Morgan Elsbeth's forces]]. His ally [[Shin Hati]] piloted<ref name="Part 3" /> a [[Shin Hati's Fiend fighter|starfighter]]<ref name="Shin Hati DB">{{Databank|shin-hati|Shin Hati}}</ref> of the same [[RP82 Fiend fighter|model]] as Marrok's Fiend.<ref name="Part 3" />

Around [[9 ABY]]<ref name="9 ABY">{{AhsokaSeriesDate}}</ref> the former [[Jedi]] [[Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano]] and her [[Mandalorian]] apprentice [[Sabine Wren]] traveled in the ''[[T-6 1974]]'' [[shuttle]] to the [[Denab system]] where the ''[[Eye of Sion]]'' was located. In response, [[Morgan Elsbeth]] dispatched Marrok in his Fiend fighter and a squadron attack on Tano's [[T-6 shuttle]], resulting in a [[Dogfight in the Denab system|dogfight]] near the [[planet]] [[Seatos]].<ref name="Part 3" />

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Marrok's Fiend fighter first appeared on screen in the third episode, [[Part Three: Time to Fly|''Time to Fly'']]<ref name="Part 3" /> which premiered in [[August 29]], 2023.<ref name="Date">{{SW|url=news/ahsoka-premiere-date|text=''Ahsoka'' Premiere Date Revealed}}</ref>
